rebuttalDraft.text: Merchant disputes Visa 13.3 chargeback for $1,845.00. The transaction was authorized on 2026-03-22 (see evidence [6e45834b-e822-54b3-93ae-3175e8602ee6]). Order #FC-2026-63301 was fulfilled exactly as described — one Scandinavian oak dining table, model FC-DT-OAK-180, as itemized on the receipt (see evidence [d5dfcf90-d692-57a5-a1a9-40c7d093d9b5] and [57844001-cea7-5ea0-8381-950833e1d6d7]). The cardholder contacted support on 2026-04-02 claiming the wood grain did not match the website photo; our agent provided a photographic comparison confirming the item is within documented natural-variation tolerances (see evidence [07fed50d-1624-5e43-9f30-fbabf48b61ae]). Delivery is confirmed by FedEx with photo proof of doorstep placement and recipient signature (see evidence [89167762-fb32-5d31-8305-0ad3d8e07527]). All evidence is complete and the chargeback has been approved for reversal.
